description: Runs an AAJ engine and returns its verdict. Give `input` as an object of the engine's fields. Omit `input` to run the engine's built-in worked example. Engines are deterministic, offline, and validate their input — a wrong unit is reported as an error, not absorbed into a confident answer.

input.description: The engine's configuration object. Some engines also accept a named mode as a plain string (for example 'design' or 'readout'). Omit for the demo.

name: run_engine
title: Run a marketing engine
